notes.content:
V 1.2 Notes Private Lobby and games added
 Top card of natural Canasta Red and of unnatural Black
 In 1v1-play 3 decks (156+6) available
 Running modes -Safemode and -Autoconfig added
 Bugfix 5:4 Screen resolutions
 Player sometimes says "Canasta" like NPCs
 Performance improved and different bugfixes

notes.title: Released now - Tips Here!
notes.content:
SUPPORTED CANASTA VARIATIONS
- default rules are mainly based on Whist Club
- specify variations by clicking Rules or Scoring button on top

TUTORIAL
- click Extras > Tutorial in main menu to learn Canasta rules

FEEL FREE
- to discuss rule variations or anything!

Details concerning game's basic rules you find in help: click Help button in the menu. If you wish other rules, let us know and discuss. We'll evaluate and expand the game!
